A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING A POLICY AUTHORIZING THE CHAIRMAN OF THE TREUTLEN COUNTY BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS TO EXPEND A SUM UP TO FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS FOR COUNTY RELATED PURCHASES, REPAIRS, AND MAINTENANCE, WITHOUT OBTAINING PRIOR APPROVAL OF THE BOARD.

On this day, the 2"4 day of September, 2013, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing a Resolution, declaring a policy, authorizing the Chairman of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners to individually expend and otherwise commit a sum up to Five Thousand ($5,000.00) dollars, without obtaining prior approval of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners, for County related purchases, repairs, and maintenance.

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners believes that it is in the best interests of Treutlen County and its citizens to be able to address County needs and concerns, without delay; and

WHEREAS, the prior practice of having the entire Board of Commissioners meet, vote, and approve every expenditure for County related purchases, repairs, and maintenance has proven not to be the most efficient method for managing the needs of the County; and

WHEREAS, many County related purchases, repairs, and maintenance expenditures are small in expense and require immediate action; and

WHEREAS, the prior practice of having to delay such a decision for a regularly scheduled meeting or called meeting of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners is not the most efficient method for addressing these concerns;

THEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such Resolution was passed unanimously, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners hereby declares and issues the following Resolution, adopting the following policy:

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners hereby establishes a policy, wherein the sitting Chairman (or Chairwoman) of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners shall be individually authorized, when acting in his or her official capacity, to solely authorize and make expenditures of up to Five Thousand ($5,000.00) dollars each, of County funds, for County related purchases, and repair and maintenance to County property. The Chairman may informally seek the advice and counsel of the other commissioners, prior to taking such action from time to time. However, in no event shall a formal vote of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners at a regularly scheduled or called meeting be required prior to the Chairman exercising such discretion. The Chairman is specifically authorized to make multiple expenditures of County funds, for County related purchases, repairs, and maintenance, of up to $5,000.00 each, without prior approval of the Board.

2

In each instance where this grant of authority is used the Chairman shall report his (or her) actions to the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners at the following meeting of the Board, for informational purposes.

Severability Clause: If any part or portion of this resolution shall be ruled invalid, unconstitutional, or otherwise unlawful, the remaining body of the resolution shall remain in full force and effect.

Repealer Clause: This resolution effectively and immediately replaces and otherwise repeals any prior conflicting ordinance, policy or resolution of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners.

Effective Date: This resolution shall become _ effective immediately.

This the 24 day of September, 2013.

Chairman of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners
